item.text:
**Bottom line**
- 5B.7 is **mixed, leaning negative** for 2024. There is real evidence of technocratic continuity in macro management, but the stronger pattern is slogan-driven justification, blame-shifting, and politically timed spending rather than visible policy correction after mistakes.

**Accepted claims**
- [Mexico: 2024 Article IV Consultation and Review Under the Flexible Credit Line Arrangement](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/11/01/mexico-2024-article-iv-consultation-and-review-under-the-flexible-credit-line-arrangement-556997) | IMF | 2024-11-01  
  The IMF said Mexico still qualified for the precautionary credit line because its macro frameworks, policy implementation record, and fundamentals were very strong, while also calling for gradual monetary normalization and a medium-term fiscal strategy. This is the clearest external evidence for evidence-based, technocratic policy handling.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.3`, `5B.6`

- [Mexican finance minister seeks to soothe investors, reduce public debt](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/mexican-finance-minister-seeks-to-soothe-investors-reduce-public-debt-3470241) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04  
  Rogelio Ramírez de la O stayed on, promised debt reduction and fiscal discipline, and explicitly backed central bank autonomy, the rule of law, and private investment. That supports a reading of expert-led macro continuity rather than pure patronage or improvisation.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.2`, `5B.3`, `5B.6`

- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay; debe más de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-15  
  The administration publicized a concrete tax-evasion case against Totalplay/Grupo Salinas and framed it as a specific enforcement matter, not a generalized excuse for favoritism. This is one of the better examples of policy grounded in case-specific evidence.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.5`

- [Economía de México es sólida y hay responsabilidad en manejo de finanzas: presidente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/economia-de-mexico-es-solida-y-hay-responsabilidad-en-manejo-de-finanzas-presidente/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-04  
  AMLO explained post-election market volatility as an external-market effect and “alarmism” from corporate media, while insisting the economic policy would not change because it had already worked. That is denial/deflection more than correction.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.3`

- [Combate a la corrupción genera ahorros y permite distribución justa de la riqueza: presidente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/combate-a-la-corrupcion-genera-ahorros-y-permite-distribucion-justa-de-la-riqueza-presidente/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-08  
  He claimed anti-corruption generated huge fiscal savings and financed welfare and infrastructure, but the argument is mostly slogan-like and self-validating rather than an explicit response to evidence of policy failure.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.5`

- [Economía Moral es mejor que el neoliberalismo: presidente; fortaleza del peso y reducción de la pobreza lo demuestran, afirma](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/economia-moral-es-mejor-que-el-neoliberalismo-presidente-fortaleza-del-peso-y-reduccion-de-la-pobreza-lo-demuestran-afirma/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-27  
  AMLO tied economic success to rejecting neoliberalism and to broad claims about poverty and peso strength, which is ideological framing rather than iterative correction of policy errors.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.3`

- [Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18  
  The government said welfare payments were advanced before the electoral blackout and warned against vote-buying. That can be read as election-safety messaging, but it also shows patronage-sensitive timing around cash transfers.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.1`, `5B.5`

- [Mexico: Staff Concluding Statement of the 2024 Article IV Mission](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/15/mcs-mexico-staff-concluding-statement-of-the-2024-aiv-mission) | IMF | 2024-10-15  
  The IMF said growth was slowing despite expansionary fiscal policy and that Mexico needed a medium-term fiscal strategy because binding capacity constraints remained. That is counterevidence to a strong correction-based policy story.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.3`, `5B.6`

- [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04  
  Reuters reported investors feared AMLO would use the post-election mandate to sweep aside checks on presidential power. This is indirect but real evidence that political control could outrank evidence-based adjustment.  
  IDs: `5B.7`, `5B.3`, `5B.5`

**Search gap**
- I did **not** find a clean 2024 example of AMLO publicly admitting an economic-policy mistake and reversing course because new evidence changed his view.
- The positive side is mostly **continuity, technocratic staffing, and external validation**.
- The negative side is stronger on **slogan-based explanation, ideological scapegoating of “neoliberalism,” claims of corruption savings, and politically timed transfers** than on outright policy collapse.
